tulsa_finding.summary: The AISC directory (snapshot and live query 2026-11-12) lists 'Arcosa Telecom Structures | Tulsa | OK' but gives no street address. No Arcosa or Ameron page, SEC filing or job listing I could fetch gives a Tulsa telecom site. The Arcosa Telecom Structures site names only Muskogee as headquarters, and Ameron Pole Products' site (Tulsa, 2333 S Yukon Ave) itself advertises Telecom Tower and Small Cell products and links to the telecom site, so the Tulsa listing is most likely Ameron's Tulsa plant (or an office) certified under the telecom entity name. Not confirmable; treated as the same site as p-ameron-tulsa-ok.
